args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all production regions.

trace.final:
Both actions completed successfully. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: Reviewing the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was an unhealthy staging build).

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions — confirmed `rolled_out` and verified.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, paging the on-call engineer, describing the health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0.
